---
title: "Sluggers"
---

```{r}
#| message: false
library(tidyverse)
library(Lahman)
```

```{r}
career_home_runs <- Batting |>
  group_by(playerID) |>
  summarize(
    career_HR = sum(HR, na.rm = TRUE),
    first_year = min(yearID),
    last_year = max(yearID),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) |>
  left_join(People |> select(playerID, nameFirst, nameLast), by = "playerID") |>
  mutate(
    `Full name` = paste(nameFirst, nameLast),
    `Steroid era status` = if_else(
      last_year >= 1994 & first_year <= 2009,
      "Active",
      "Not active"
    )
  ) |>
  arrange(desc(career_HR)) |>
  slice_head(n = 15)

ggplot(
  career_home_runs,
  aes(
    x = career_HR,
    y = forcats::fct_reorder(`Full name`, career_HR),
    fill = `Steroid era status`
  )
) +
  geom_col() +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c("Active" = "firebrick", "Not active" = "gray65")) +
  labs(
    title = "Career home runs by the top 15 sluggers",
    x = "Career home runs",
    y = "Player",
    fill = "Active during steroid era",
    caption = "Source: Lahman database. Steroid era defined as 1994-2009."
  )
```

## Barry Bonds by season

```{r}
barry_bonds_home_runs <- Batting |>
  filter(playerID == "bondsba01") |>
  group_by(yearID) |>
  summarize(home_runs = sum(HR, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop")

ggplot(barry_bonds_home_runs, aes(x = yearID, y = home_runs)) +
  geom_col(fill = "firebrick") +
  labs(
    title = "Barry Bonds' home runs by season",
    x = "Season",
    y = "Home runs"
  )
```
